assets.purpose: Optional Halloween dressing of the hub for the 10/31 beta weekend (needs user OK, otherwise next year)
assets.firefly_prompt_en: A fantasy town plaza at dusk dressed for a cute harvest festival: smiling pumpkin lanterns around a three-tier fountain, purple and orange string lights, friendly little ghost-shaped paper lanterns, candy bowls, a giant broken golden crown floating in the sky. Chunky stylized 3D cartoon render with blocky toy-like props, cozy and cute, not scary, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.negative_notes: Reject gravestones, skeletons, cobwebs with spiders and blood. Must stay Minimal-maturity friendly.

extra_ideas_ko: [사용자 결정 필요] 10/31 베타가 핼러윈 당일이에요. 교차로 핼러윈 꾸밈(호박 등불·사탕 그릇)과 핼러윈 후광·뿔·톱니 스킨을 베타에 넣을까요? 넣으면 시안 4장과 3D 부품 작업이 반나절 정도 늘어요. 안 넣으면 내년에 써요.
[사용자 결정 필요] 4·5계급에 내 아바타 등에 작은 날개가 생겨도 될까요? 카메라와 남을 가리지 않게 작게 만들고, 날개는 겉모습뿐이에요(능력 없음).
[사용자 결정 필요] 예전에 승인한 게임 아이콘(GameIcon, 치비 3D 풍)과 괴수 썸네일을 그대로 쓸까요, 로블록스 스타일로 Firefly 새 시안을 뽑을까요? (RELEASE_PLAN: 승인 시안 먼저 확인)
시즌 스킨 규칙: 고리·두 뿔·톱니 모양은 절대 안 바꾸고 재질과 장식만 바꿔요. 무료 이벤트 보상이고 매년 돌아오며 '마지막 기회' 같은 압박 문구는 쓰지 않아요. 나중에 '사탕 20개 → 호박 후광' 교환 같은 방식도 좋아요.
펫 진화(천사·악마·균형) 모습을 후광·뿔 성장 시안과 같은 말투로 맞춰요. 천사 펫은 작은 후광과 깃털, 악마 펫은 작은 뿔과 박쥐 날개, 균형 펫은 청록 톱니예요. 승인된 성장 시안을 스타일 참조로 붙이면 한 세계처럼 보여요.
계급이 오르는 순간 새 배지를 기존 레벨업 배너에 크게 한 번 보여 줘요. 새 화면은 필요 없어요. 남들도 이름표 옆 배지와 커진 후광·뿔로 바로 알아봐요.
전쟁 결과 무대: 이긴 진영 깃발이 교차로 분수 둘레에 10분 걸리고, 하늘에는 금빛 후광 해나 진홍 월식 달이 떠요. 3D 모델 없이 Decal과 Sky 그림만 바꾸면 돼요.
왕관 조각 색 하나로 이야기를 이어요. 퀘스트 선택(정화·삼킴·다듬기), 분수 위 조각 빛(전쟁 결과 색), 지도 왕관 아이콘이 모두 같은 조각 모양을 써요.
지도 아이콘은 지역 입장 알림(존 이름 배너)과 다음 목표 줄 아이콘으로 다시 써요. 그림 18장으로 화면 세 곳이 함께 좋아져요.
현상수배 게시판에 빈 포스터 그림을 깔고 이름·별·현상금을 게임 글자로 올려요. 악당 TOP3가 진짜 수배지처럼 보여서 기사단이 쫓아갈 이유가 커져요.
감정 스티커 휠(정식 이후): 고마워·도와줘·메롱·복수다·좋아·미안해 6개를 글 없이 그림만으로 써요. 같은 스티커는 쿨다운이 있고, 메롱은 같은 사람에게 연속으로 못 쓰게 해요.
'저주받은 알'은 이름만 남기고 그림은 귀여운 장난꾸러기 밤 알로 그려요. 아이 대상이라 무섭지 않게 하고, 심의 답변도 쉬워져요.
Firefly 크레딧 절약: 가족마다 첫 장(또는 5계급 배지)만 후보 4장, 나머지는 승인작을 스타일 참조로 붙여 2장씩 뽑아요. 이 영역 103장 기준 약 230~260번 생성이에요. 베타분 28장은 약 70번이에요.
베타 작업 순서 제안: 재료·사탕·주문서·물약 15장 → Q·Z 스킬 6장 → 감정 스티커 5장 → 지도 양피지 → 왕관 조각 기본. 아이템 목록·드랍 알림·Z 버튼이 10/24 전에 새 그림을 바로 쓰는 순서예요.
다른 세션과 겹칠 수 있는 것: 물약 아이콘 2장은 HUD 세션이 이미 그렸다면 그쪽 승인작을 쓰고 여기서는 빼요. 진영 엠블럼은 진영 화면 세션 결과를 깃발·배지의 스타일 참조로 써요.

problems.asset_or_area: ALL areas: shared style blocks
problems.issue: The five areas use five incompatible style blocks, so icons that share one inventory or drop list will look like they come from different games. UI CORE says 'crisp clean vector-like rendering, glossy'. Pets say 'low-poly ... soft subtle facets, smooth matte vinyl', which contradicts itself. Weapons say 'blocky low-poly shapes, smooth matte plastic'. More-than-asked says 'chunky glossy 3D cartoon'. Characters say '3D-rendered ... smooth matte plastic'. The conflicts are glossy vs matte, flat vector vs 3D render, and faceted vs smooth. Weapon icons, materials, scrolls, potions, eggs and pet stat icons all appear side by side in Menu > 아이템 and in drop toasts.
problems.fix: Route every prompt through the single global guide below. Use one material phrase ('soft glossy toy plastic') and one render phrase ('3D-rendered'). Family blocks only add framing. Remove 'vector-like' from UI CORE. Run the pets A/B style lock once (faceted or smooth), then use only the winning phrase for pets, eggs and forms.

problems.asset_or_area: ALL icon/UI families: outline colour
problems.issue: The outline ink differs by area. UI and weapons use dark navy #1B2140. More-than-asked uses dark plum #1E1A20. Pet icons use an unspecified 'clean dark rim'. Pet UI parts use 'thin warm brown'. Characters have none. Material, skill, badge and map icons will not match the weapon icons or the UI kit.
problems.fix: Use one ink for every UI part, icon, glyph, badge, map marker, sticker and item: 'thick even dark navy outline' (#1B2140). Use no outline only on characters, 3D concepts, Tripo inputs, scenes, banners and FX textures. Rewrite ICON_W/ICON_D/SKILL/BADGE/MAP/STICKER (more-than-asked) and the pets ICON/UI PART blocks.

problems.asset_or_area: UI BG_D + GLYPH; more-than-asked ICON_D, SKILL, BADGE_D, MAP_D
problems.issue: Dark-outlined subjects are generated on dark backgrounds: a navy outline on 'dark charcoal' (all UIP_Glyph*, FactionCardHalo, FactionTitle, ClassCardHalo, TitleRibbon, ListRow*, InputField, Chip, LevelBadgeHalo, AutoRingOn, PetCard, EventBannerWinter) and a plum outline on 'dark navy' (all Skill_* x9, Item_Enh*/Move* x6, Item_GoblinTooth, Item_Bone, Badge_HaloR1-5, Badge_GrayLegend, Mark_Redeem, Map_HaloCastle, Map_SkeletonRuins, Shard_Purified, Egg_Dawn). Remove background cannot separate a near-black outline from a near-black background. It will eat or fringe the outline, which breaks the user-confirmed cutout rule. Stickers are fine because their white die-cut border separates them.
problems.fix: Default to 'isolated on a plain flat medium-gray background with a wide empty margin' for every cut-out subject, including white, cream and ivory ones, since the dark outline gives the edge. Use plain white only for gray, silver, stone or bone subjects. Use pure black only for luminance-alpha FX and additive sky textures. Never put navy, charcoal or slate behind a dark-outlined subject.

problems.asset_or_area: UI, pets, weapons, more-than-asked prompts: negations and trigger words
problems.issue: Firefly has no reliable negative prompt (the characters research notes Adobe paused it), so 'no X' can add X. Four of the five areas put negated kid-safety trigger words in the positive text: UIP_FactionCardHorns 'no skull, not scary'; Map_SkeletonRuins 'no skulls'; Thumb_C_Halloween 'no skulls'; Badge_HornsR4/R5, Shard_Swallowed, Map_Kaiju, Emo_Cheeky, CON-style 'not scary'; plus 'no text, no letters, no numbers' and 'no hands, no characters' on almost every asset. Only the characters area writes positively.
problems.fix: Rewrite every prompt positively, as the characters area does. Examples: 'wordless, blank unmarked surfaces'; 'cute friendly prankster look, big round eyes, smiling'; 'a big glossy toy helmet crest with two curved red horns'; 'broken pale stone pillars with a soft purple flame'. Never write skull, blood, fang, demon, gore or scary in a prompt, even negated. Use Firefly's Exclude field only if the chosen model shows one; otherwise negative_notes are the QA checklist only.

problems.asset_or_area: Cross-area duplicates
problems.issue:
About 25 assets are designed twice or three times, with conflicting looks, which multiplies the user's one-by-one approvals:
- Rarity slots: UIP_Slot* (navy inner, epic = amethyst + wings), UI_RarityFrame_* (cream inner, epic = corner stars), UIP_GradeSlotBack/Rim (tintable).
- Stars: UIP_StarFull/Empty vs UIP_GradeStar.
- Rays: UIP_RewardRays, UIP_LootRays, UI_HatchRays.
- Sparkles: FX_PetSparkleHalo vs Fx_Sparkle4.
- Eggs: pets Egg_Meadow/Forest/Ruins/Dawn/Cursed/Gear vs more Egg_Slime/Goblin/Dawn/Night/Nest. Egg_Dawn is the same id with different prompts.
- Banners: BAN_* (cut-out) vs Banner_* (opaque).
- UI_WantedPoster: same id, two designs.
- Pet cards: UIP_PetCard vs UI_PetCard.
- Paw icons: UIP_GlyphPaw vs Icon_PetPaw.
- Nest keeper: pets NPC_NestKeeper (cream shirt, brown overalls) vs characters FB/PTR_NestKeeper (mustard, denim, chick hat).
- World map: illustrated UIP_MapBoard vs blank UI_MapParchment plus 18 Map_* icons.
problems.fix:
Give each asset one owner and drop the rest before generating:
- Slots and stars go to the UI kit (6 slots, with colour + ornament per grade, and 1-2 stars).
- All rays and sparkles become one luminance FX set.
- Pets owns eggs and pet UI.
- Characters owns NPCs (FB/PTR_NestKeeper).
- Keep the opaque Banner_* (correct for 3D flag Decals).
- Keep one UI_WantedPoster.
- Choose one map approach. Blank parchment plus icons is safer: there is no fake text and it is easier to keep accurate.
The orchestrator can decide all of this without asking the user.

problems.asset_or_area: Characters CORE_H ('building-block game figure')
problems.issue: 'Building-block game figure' is the strongest cue for brick-toy minifigures: studs, C-shaped claw hands and cylinder heads. That is an IP look-alike risk, and it is also not the target platform look. The prompt then tries to suppress the drift only in negative_notes.
problems.fix: Remove 'building-block'. Use '3D-rendered blocky toy-avatar character with a cube-shaped head, one straight rectangular block torso and rectangular arms and legs'. Keep the pets/more wording 'blocky toy-avatar' as the only shared term.

problems.asset_or_area: PTR_GuideHalo, PTR_GuideArtisan, PTR_NestKeeper (female), PTR_GuideHorns, PTR_SkillTeacher, PTR_MerchantC, PTR_PotionMerchant
problems.issue: None of the head-and-shoulders portrait prompts includes the MODEST token. They describe a collar or armor only. The old account was suspended over revealing female characters. Female portraits are where Firefly most often adds a neckline, open collar or bare shoulders, and portraits are shown large (170 px) in the welcome dialog.
problems.fix: Insert the MODEST sentence right after the subject in every portrait, for example: 'wears a high-collared long-sleeved top that fully covers the neck, shoulders and chest'. QA reject: any visible neck skin below the jaw, collarbone or shoulder.

problems.asset_or_area: All female CLS_*_F, FB_Guide*, CRW_MarketVendor
problems.issue: The prompts rely on 'block-shaped limbs shared by every character' late in a long prompt. Firefly reliably feminizes female figures: shaped torso, hips, makeup, a tighter fit.
problems.fix: Put 'one straight rectangular block torso identical to the male version' in the first sentence. Generate the M version first, then the F version with the approved M as Structure reference (about 70%), changing only hair and face paint. QA: overlay the F and M silhouettes, and reject if the torso outline differs.

problems.asset_or_area: Halloween faces: CON_LittleGhost, CON_PumpkinKing, Thumb_C_Halloween, UIP_EventBannerHalloween, Weapon_*_Pumpkin, WeaponConcept_PumpkinLantern, Season_HaloHalloween, Concept_HalloweenCrossroads
problems.issue: Firefly's default jack-o'-lantern has triangle eyes, a jagged carved mouth and an inner fire glare. 'Big friendly dark eyes' on a ghost tends to produce hollow black ghost eyes. 'Lantern face with big round glowing eyes' (PumpkinKing) reads spooky. These monsters roam beginner zones during the beta, so this matters for the Minimal maturity label.
problems.fix: Replace every 'jack-o'-lantern' with 'a smiling pumpkin face with big round eyes and a soft curved smile, warm glow'. Ghost: 'big round eyes with white shine highlights and rosy cheeks'. PumpkinKing: 'big round eyes with pupils and shine' instead of 'glowing eyes'. QA: zero triangle eyes and zero jagged teeth.

problems.asset_or_area: Thumb_C_Halloween, Thumb_B_HuntLoot, Thumb_D_Pets, GameIcon_C_BabySlime
problems.issue: Marketing prompts contradict the creature designs. Thumb_C asks for 'a little goblin with bat wings', but CON_BatGoblin explicitly rejects anatomical wings in favour of a costume cape. Thumb_B's king slime has no colour (in-game BigSlime is blue) and its baby slime is unspecified. GameIcon_C and Thumb_D use 'baby green jelly slime', while the pets Q1-A recommendation is pale mint-white with a sprout. Roblox thumbnail guidance also wants art that matches the real game.
problems.fix: Generate thumbnails and icons last. Attach the approved CON_*, Pet_BabySlime and CLS_* images as Style/Structure references, and copy their descriptions: 'a goblin wearing a purple bat-ear hood and bat-wing costume cape, holding a pumpkin candy bucket'; 'big blue king slime'; 'pale mint-white baby slime with a leaf sprout'. Prefer in-engine Studio captures with Firefly backgrounds and FX where possible.

problems.asset_or_area: CON_SkeletonKing
problems.issue: 'Round skull with big round eye sockets glowing soft purple' is the classic horror read: a glowing-socket skull, even with a goofy body. As the final boss and the face of the ruins, it will appear in toasts, map icons and maybe thumbnails.
problems.fix: Use 'cartoon skeleton king with a round toy-like head, big round eyes with pupils and white shine, rosy cheek dots, a grumpy-funny frown, a long purple robe covering the whole body'. Keep it out of thumbnails and the game icon.

problems.asset_or_area: Decal_AltarSigil, Map_Altar, Skill_Mage_X, UIP_* 'magic circle' wording
problems.issue: 'Carved floor sigil', 'stone altar' with a half-crimson glow and 'glowing violet magic circle' invite occult or ritual geometry (pentagram-like stars, rune rings) and a sacrificial-altar look, with crimson that reads as blood. That is a moderation and parent-trust risk.
problems.fix: Decal_AltarSigil: 'round carved stone floor medallion split straight down the middle, gold half with a ring, crimson half with two small horns, small golden crown in the centre'. Map_Altar: 'small rounded stone pedestal glowing warm gold on one side and crimson on the other'. Skill_Mage_X: 'a glowing violet ring of simple dots and circles around a small cute snail'. Never use 'sigil', 'altar', 'pentagram' or 'rune circle'.

problems.asset_or_area: Text-prone props: Emo_Ouch, Bubble_PetMood_Set, FB_SkillTeacher, Map_SkillTeacher, Item_Enh*/Move* wax seals, UIP_MapBoard, UIP_GlyphMap, Map_Compass, UI_CodexStamp, Icon_CodexMedal, FxKill_Coin, UI_WantedPoster, Prop_PetNest awning, Map_Market, ribbon banners
problems.issue: Speech bubbles, book pages, seals, maps, compass roses, rubber stamps, medals, coins, posters and shop awnings are where Firefly most often paints gibberish lettering. The trailing 'no text' does not stop it, and fake glyphs break KO/EN localisation and can form unintended words.
problems.fix: Describe these props as blank, positively: 'blank pages', 'plain unmarked wax seal with a simple arrow shape', 'unlabeled glass bottle', 'smooth blank parchment', 'plain striped awning'. For Emo_Ouch, write 'a white jagged starburst shape with a large flat empty centre' and avoid the words 'speech bubble'. QA every candidate at 400% zoom for letter-like marks.

problems.asset_or_area: Icon_PetStatSpeed, Emo_Cheeky, Emo_Sorry, Skill_Archer_X
problems.issue: Icon_PetStatSpeed asks for a 'sneaker boot' with 'speed swoosh lines'. 'Swoosh' plus a sneaker invites a sportswear-brand mark. 'Emoji' (Emo_Cheeky, Emo_Sorry) pulls toward platform emoji designs. The pet speed icon and Skill_Archer_X are also both winged boots, so the two are easy to confuse.
problems.fix: Remove 'swoosh', 'sneaker' and 'emoji'. Pet speed: 'a small paw print with three curved wind lines'. Keep the winged boot only for Skill_Archer_X. Stickers: 'a round cartoon face sticker'.

problems.asset_or_area: Pet_BabySlime, Pet_JellySnail, Pet_CrownJelly, CON_PumpkinSlime, CON_SlimeRound, Item_Jelly, Item_SlimeCore
problems.issue: 'Semi-translucent' or 'translucent' jelly makes Remove background punch holes or keep background colour inside the body. It also gives Tripo a see-through texture. The weapons area already solved this, but the pets, characters and more-than-asked areas did not.
problems.fix: Use 'glossy opaque jelly with soft inner highlights and white shine spots' for every cut-out icon and Tripo input. Keep any translucency as an in-engine Transparency setting on the 3D part.

problems.asset_or_area: UIP_RewardRays, UIP_BannerGold rays, UIP_AutoRingOn sparkles, UIP_ListRowSelected inner glow, Pet_DawnLamb glow, PetForm_* sparkles, Shard_Purified sparkles
problems.issue: Soft glows and light rays are cut out with Remove background (UI) instead of the luminance-alpha method used by pets and weapons. The AI remover leaves gray or black halos and drops faint sparkles as detached specks.
problems.fix: Keep glows inside the outline on sprites ('glow and sparkles painted inside the outline'). Make every free-floating glow, ray or sparkle part of the single shared FX set (white on pure black, then luminance to alpha, tinted in code). Generate BannerGold without rays and use the shared rays layer behind it.

problems.asset_or_area: Floating or hollow parts: CLS_* halo ring and gear emblem, Egg_Dawn, Pet_DawnLamb, PetForm_Balance, Shard_Purified, UIP_PortraitRing, UIP_AutoRingOn, bows
problems.issue: Halos and gears floating above heads and items, ring holes and bowstring gaps are the parts Remove background most often drops, fills or leaves with background inside. The result is a 'successful' cutout with a missing faction mark or a solid ring.
problems.fix: Make 'halo hole and bowstring gaps fully transparent; floating halo/gear kept' an explicit QA line. Fill holes locally with a mask when needed. For Tripo inputs, leave floating halos and gears out, since they are built in-engine (as the characters area already does).

problems.asset_or_area: Long prompts (CLS_*, FB_*, Thumb_*, WeaponConcept_*, UI CORE assets)
problems.issue: Many prompts run 900-1,300 characters, with the safety clauses (MODEST, background, wordless) at the end, and UI CORE repeats itself ('polished gold trim' twice). If Firefly truncates or down-weights tail tokens, the safety and background clauses are the first to be lost.
problems.fix: Fixed order: subject, then MODEST/creature-safety token, then faction token, then one family style block, then background, then wordless. Aim for about 700 characters or less and remove duplicated phrases. Check the current Firefly prompt length limit once in the UI before batch work.

problems.asset_or_area: 9-slice UI parts (PanelMain, PanelDark, DialogBox, ListRow*, BarTrack, Btn*, Chip, StatusPlate, QuestRow, Toast)
problems.issue: Firefly does not produce truly even borders, mirror symmetry or a flat centre. Uneven corners and a center gradient will stretch visibly with long English strings.
problems.fix: Approve the look, then symmetrize (mirror the better half), flatten the centre and measure SliceCenter in prep_ui. Show the processed file as the approval candidate, so the approved image is exactly what ships.

problems.asset_or_area: Item slots vs icons (UIP_Slot*, UIP_GradeSlotBack) with navy-outlined icons
problems.issue: Weapon and item icons with a thick dark navy outline sit on a 'dark navy recessed inner area'. The silhouette edge falls below the 3:1 icon contrast target the UI area itself set, which hurts readability at 48 px on phones.
problems.fix: Make the slot interior a lighter mid-tone, such as a soft slate-blue gradient or the cream used by pets, while keeping the navy rim. Verify icon-edge contrast of 3:1 or more at 48 px before approving the slot set.

problems.asset_or_area: Style references and icon fill ratios
problems.issue: There are seven or more competing anchors: iron sword, baby slime, Item_Jelly, Skill_Warrior_Q, Badge R5, Emo_Ouch and CLS_HaloWarrior_M. Fill ratios also differ (75%, 80%, 85%, 90%). Inventory icons from different anchors and fills will drift in style and size.
problems.fix: Use one Firefly model for the whole project. Use four masters: UI (UIP_PanelMain), icon (Weapon_Warrior_T3) for ALL inventory, item, egg and stat icons, human (CLS_HaloWarrior_M) and creature (Pet_BabySlime). Every asset attaches its family master as Style reference at 60-70. Fill is 80% for inventory icons and 75% for round skill buttons.

problems.asset_or_area: Pets UI PART BLOCK (UI_PetNameTag, UI_PetCard, UI_CodexBook, UI_CodexSlotUnknown)
problems.issue: The pets area specifies 'soft painted toy style, thin warm brown outline, medium grey bg' for its UI parts, which contradicts the approved-direction UI kit (navy + gold trim + cream). Its own note says to match the HUD kit, but the prompt block does the opposite.
problems.fix: Generate pet UI with UI CORE + SLICE and the approved UI master as Style reference, and remove the pets UI PART BLOCK. The paw notch, paw corners and sticker-book idea stay as subject words.

problems.asset_or_area: 'Holy' wording and church motifs: CLS_HaloWarrior_* ('Holy paladin'), Weapon_*_T7_Halo / WeaponConcept_Dawn ('holy dawn'), UIP_FactionCardHalo ('holy knights'), Decal_HaloWindow ('stained-glass rose window')
problems.issue: 'Holy' and rose windows make Firefly add crosses and church iconography, which are real-world religious symbols the designs elsewhere try to exclude.
problems.fix: Use 'radiant', 'sunlit' or 'light knight'. Describe the window as 'a round colourful glass medallion with a gold ring and feather pattern'. Fantasy halo, wings and sunburst only.

problems.asset_or_area: 'Devil'/'villain'/'doom' wording: PetForm_Devil_Ref, Horns class/NPC tokens, WeaponConcept_Ruin
problems.issue: 'Little-devil form' and 'cartoon villain army' pull toward demon faces, fire and menace, which the negative_notes then have to reject.
problems.fix: Use 'cheeky imp costume' for the pet form and 'mischievous prankster crew' for Horns. Keep the in-game names (악마, 파멸) as text only.

problems.asset_or_area: UI_WantedPoster (real avatar headshot), Emo_Cheeky
problems.issue: Kid-social risk: a 'wanted' poster showing another child's real avatar, and a tongue-out taunt sticker, can become bullying tools.
problems.fix: Only players who earned a bounty through their own Horns actions appear, with a headshot and a filtered display name, using playful bounty framing. Emo_Cheeky gets a per-target cooldown (already proposed); keep both server-gated.

problems.asset_or_area: Names: Sky_MoonEclipse (핏빛), Item_GoblinTooth ('fang')
problems.issue: Blood wording in an asset name, and 'fang' in a prompt, nudge both reviewers and Firefly toward gore.
problems.fix: Rename it to 진홍 월식 달. Item_GoblinTooth prompt: 'one big smooth rounded cream tooth with a leather cord'.
